prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1325; do not mention it.)
text:
I write to advise that this firm now represents the interests of our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes and was sideswiped by the vehicle insured under your policy. Our client sustained injuries in this incident and is entitled to seek compensation for those injuries and related losses.

Effective immediately, please direct all further communication regarding this claim to this office and do not contact our client directly. Please also provide, within the time permitted by law, a complete statement of the liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, including any applicable excess or umbrella coverage.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, witness statements, dashcam or surveillance footage, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and the claim file. Any loss or alteration of such material may prejudice our client's position.

We look forward to your prompt written confirmation of receipt of this letter.
